acts.name: The Edge Of Rock
acts.blurb: A Villages homegrown rock band delivering thrilling, high-energy renditions of classic rock and crowd favorites.

acts.name: Bandemic
acts.blurb: Bandemic is the ultimate musical outbreak! Spreading 40+ years of rock ‘n’ roll fever from classic '80s to country-rock.

acts.name: Rocky and The Rollers
acts.blurb: An absolute Villages favorite. Rocky and The Rollers have 27 years performing in The Villages and their wide range of high energy music from all eras and genres will keep you excited and engaged throughout the performance.

acts.name: Hacksaw Hamlin
acts.blurb: Hacksaw Hamlin is a dynamic and versatile four piece band that combines danceable elements of '70s rock, blues, and country.

acts.name: Uncle Bob's Rock Shop
acts.blurb: Live in Concert – This is Uncle Bob's Rock Shop. Playing iconic classic rock hits with a genuine concert feel.

acts.name: Bar Fly
acts.blurb: Bar Fly raises the bar with a buzz-worthy mix of rock, soul, and swagger playing hits from the '70s, the '80s and beyond!

acts.name: Zee-R Band
acts.blurb: Zee-R is an international artist originally from Brazil. Zee's repertoire consists of family-friendly classic hits from all eras.

acts.name: Radlin' Rootz
acts.blurb: Radlin' Rootz is an eclectic cover/original band that is comprised of top tier musicians from Ocala, FL.

acts.name: Watkins Duo
acts.blurb: Watkins Duo : Thomas and Susan play the hits you know and love, from the 1970s-1990s. DeadLanders : DeadLanders is a local band from DeLand, FL, that specializes in country, classic, and southern rock.

acts.name: The Brothers Jukebox
acts.blurb: Spinning country gold and classic rock with heart. The Brothers Jukebox delivers down-home harmonies, front-porch memories, and the kind of sound that keeps life sweet, smooth, and simple.

acts.name: Greg Warren Band
acts.blurb: High energy country, classic rock, rock, and dance band. We like to keep you dancing all night!

acts.name: September Dogs

acts.name: Johnny Wild & The Delights
acts.blurb: Johnny Wild & the Delights are your true time machine back to the classic music and style of the '50s and '60s.

acts.blurb: Beats, lights, repeat — DJ Lu-S is taking full CTRL of the night, flipping the switch to club-mode and keeping the momentum pumping all night long.
